retained_failures: Initial process-harness expectation of universal cleanup was invalid; tests now require UNKNOWN and retained port after ambiguous server intent, without weakening deletion/accounting controls

limits: No terminal guarantee for late provider effects

No copied-host takeover or distributed fencing
